The `memo` table is in the SQLite `LATEST.sql` (postgres and mysql have matching `LATEST.sql` files). `type Memo struct` is in `store/memo.go`. The API `message Memo` is in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. The generated frontend `export type Memo` is in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
